instruction: Find the 2018 Super Bowl game summary on the NFL website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the 2018 Super Bowl (post4) scores page. Very similar to the original task which targeted 2019 Super Bowl, just different year. Same URL pattern and navigation steps.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to find/navigate to the 2018 Super Bowl game summary
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) appropriately extracts the active tab URL from Chrome
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the result URL with the expected URL using compare_urls for normalization
Expected URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2018/post4' is semantically correct for 2018 Super Bowl (post4 = Super Bowl in NFL URL structure)
Complete coverage: instruction has one main requirement (navigate to page) and evaluator verifies this requirement
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts URL → metric compares → returns 1.0 for match, 0.0 for no match
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 for None/empty URLs, compare_urls handles URL normalization
